name: cmd
description: cmd's design tokens (DTCG 2025.10). The base set, then a light appearance (light themes), reduced motion, and the surface they're used on: the app, or a Magic widget's frame. pnpm tokens builds them into packages/ui/src/tokens.css and tokens.gen.ts, and the widget frame's packages/core/src/magic/prompt/tokens.css.

base.description: Everything, tuned for dark themes. theme.tokens.json documents what each theme sets at runtime.

appearance.description: The active theme's appearance; applied at runtime (themeVars).

motion.description: prefers-reduced-motion; emitted as a media query.

surface.description: Where the tokens are used: the app, or inside a Magic widget (adds the widget names and Magic's older ones).
